Chronic Morbidity"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: left;\" trbidi=\"on\"\u003E\nI am 31 unmarried,\u0026nbsp; completed my MSC computers, and I used to work as examination branch incharge in degree college with decent salary. Now due to my chronic illness I left my job for 2 years.. all my money got used up for investigations and treatment of my illness but I never felt better.. I lost all my friends, my happiness and all.. I am feeling worthless. If I were alright I would have married by now.. my wedding got delayed because of this illness..\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nWhat happened to u?\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n3 yrs back one day while I was lying on my bed I had sudden sensation of something got cut inside my body over the sternal region and when I got up next day in the morning my abdomen has distended and by afternoon my legs and hands are swollen (pitting type of edema) I think my face is not swollen, I got so weak that I was unable to do routine activities, unable to comb my hair, I couldn't even lift small weights, so I went to hospital the next day where I was sent for x-ray chest and ECG.. every investigation turned out to be normal, they just gave me some multivitamins and sent me.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nLater after 3 days I had chicken meat and lamb meat after which I developed joint pains (wrists,elbows,shoulders,his,knees,ankles) picking type of pain.. no tenderness, no swelling, no restriction of movements, and generalized weakness for which I used medication for 1week after which my pain was subsided but not my weakness.. my abdominal distension and pedal edema got slowly resolved.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nAs I was developing frequent abdominal distension I used homeopathy for 1 year.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n2 years back, I noticed that I was developing iching in the hands \u0026amp; legs after eating meat when I rub them the skin used to peel off followed by development of some papule kind of thing which used to subside by leaving black pigmentation over my skin in the hands and legs. It's not just one time I noticed, but every time I take meat. So I gave up my favourite foods and I restricted myself to vegetables. I was alright for quite some period of time.. later even with vegetables I used to develop same skin lesions. I could not tolerate the itching and lesions so I gave up every food.. I stopped eating veggies, fruits, everything. Now since 6 months I was taking only white rice with water.. nothing else except these two and I observed no skin lesions are appearing newly since 6months.. so I was continuing with the same diet.. but I am feeling hungry more than before in such a way that, I eat 7 to 8 times a day, just that white rice. All these 2 years I used to have vomitings and diarrhoea. Vomitings 3 to 4 episodes\/day more or less daily. Diarrhoea 3 to 4 episodes\/day (sometimes normal volume, some times loose stools)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nAnd I was also having itching over genital area since 2 yrs. In this span of 2 years, intermittently I used have severe pain in my legs, a\/w tingling and burning sensation in feet, I couldn't tolerate the pain so I used to tie my legs with ropes or clothes tightly.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nI have sinus problem since 4 yrs which aggravates with weather changes. I also have some photosensitivity since 2yrs I think.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nMy Menstrual history is normal\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nI used multiple drugs but all gone in vain. I just want to get rid of this illness..please help me\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nGeneral examination: pallor + edema of legs grade-1 and multiple hyper pigmented patches over hands and legs\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nsystemic examination is more or less normal\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDermatology referral was done in view of skin lesions: O\/E no active lesions are seen\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nMultiple hyperpigmented macules seen over arms, forearms and legs.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nO\/E of oral mucosa white lacy pattern is seen.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNails are normal (no flattening noticed)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nVaginal examination showed Curdy white discharge adherent to the vaginal walls s\/o Vaginal Candidiasis.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPsychiatry referral was done i\/v\/o depression but she denied any depression.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDiscussion:\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nwhat does she actually mean by sensation of something got cut......? is it reliable? Does it have something to do with the symptoms of our pt?\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nwhat is the reason for her long history of diarrhea and vomitings?\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nIs she right in saying that she is allergic to all kinds of food? Are those skin lesions really have something to do with the skin lesions?\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nis she psychologically depressed? Did we take correct decision in sending her to Psychiatry? Does she require some more sessions in Psychiatry?\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nShe is so weak that she gave up her job (due to this chronic morbidity). How can we help her and give her life back?\u003C\/div\u003E\n"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/bmjsanjana.blogspot.com\/feeds\/4175519949313295902\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/bmjsanjana.blogspot.com\/2019\/03\/unexplained-chronic-morbidity.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/6645350221940674831\/posts\/default\/4175519949313295902"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/6645350221940674831\/posts\/default\/4175519949313295902"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/bmjsanjana.blogspot.com\/2019\/03\/unexplained-chronic-morbidity.html","title":"Unexplained Chronic Morbidity"}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"Sanjana"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/06601932220744693330"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}},{"id":{"$t":"tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-6645350221940674831.post-7414493477473735547"},"published":{"$t":"2019-03-17T12:12:00.001-07:00"},"updated":{"$t":"2019-03-17T12:18:50.372-07:00"},"title":{"type":"text","$t":"Fever with Migratory Poly-arthritis"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: left;\" trbidi=\"on\"\u003E\n12 yr old boy was brought by parents to the OPD with the c\/c fever on \u0026amp; off and joint pains since 2 months.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nMother tells 'my child is 12yr old. He is always active, his school performance is good..\u0026nbsp; He was admitted in hostel 2yrs back. On 25th of December 2018, we received a call from hostel that our boy is having cold and fever for which we brought him home. We took him to hospital and it was recorded as high grade fever a\/w chills, no rigors and the fever got subsided with medication for about 3 days. And as he was back to normal we sent him to hostel.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHe returned home on 14th of January 2019 for vacation, and I noticed that my son is limping and something is wrong with his left leg. On asking he denied and said it was all okay.. he again developed high grade fever on 18th of January with pain and swelling in the left ankle joint and was unable to walk for which we took him to govt.hospital where he was given calcium supplementation. After that he felt better and we sent him back to school on 24th of January.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n4days later he fell down while playing and was unable to walk from then. So we consulted orthopaedic doctor where they advised X-rays and he was managed by POP \u0026amp; Traction for about 4 days. He was allowed to walk on 5th day. But he could not walk properly and during all this period he developed fever intermittently. he also had tremors in hands during episodes of fever.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nAfter 1 week not satisfied by his outcome and on suggestion from neighbors we took our child to another orthopaedic doctor where he was again supplemented with calcium. After a week he developed swelling and pain in the right knee and right ankle along with restriction of movements. So we took him to higher center where again he was given calcium supplementation and they also done mantoux which was negative.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nAfter 15 days he also developed pain,swelling and restriction of movements in the right elbow. Now pain and swelling decreased in the right knee and right ankle joint but are persisting in left ankle joint and right elbow joint along with restriction of movements. Boy denied any history of sore throat. Mother is telling that he lost around 10kg in the span of 3 months. No h\/o rash during this period. No h\/o chest pain. No restriction of movements of other small and large joints.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPast history: no h\/o chronic joint pains or swelling\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nFamily history: nil significant\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBirth history: normal\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nImmunization history: immunized till date, BCG scar +\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDevelopmental history: attained mile stones normally as per age and peer group\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDiet history: calorie deficiency:450kcal\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nOn examination,\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nChild is active, afebrile.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nModerately built and nourished\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nVitals\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTemp: 98.6°F\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPulse: 112bpm\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nRR:18cpm\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSwelling in the right elbow and left ankle joint are seen.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTenderness is elicited in right elbow, left knee, and right ankle joint.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBoy is limping\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNo skin rashes\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSystemic examination\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCVS: S1,S2 heard, No murmurs. No cardiac enlargement\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nRS: B\/L NVBS heard, lungs are clear on both sides.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nGIT: soft, non tender no organomegaly.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCNS: NFND\u003Cbr I was the first child for my parents I had two brothers. Both of them are completely normal. I used to walk normally like other kids.. I used to play.. my thighs started bending (bowing) slowly when I was 7. It gradually progressed and I developed knock knees for which I had surgery at the age of 10 yrs for my left leg and at the age of 12 yrs for my right leg (B\/L supracondylar osteotomy) I was quite normal for about some time then again my thighs started bowing again. I started using stick at the age of 15, I always needed someone to hold me while I walk.. I had multiple fractures in my left lower leg with trivial trauma.
